# Phase 7 — Governed Agent Runtime

Follow Copilot instructions and AGENT-EXECUTION-MODEL, lifecycle, policy, model-provider and security docs. Implement bounded orchestration/planning and execution separation, step/time/token limits, cancellation, validated action proposals, safe error recovery, and route every action proposal through Policy Engine and Runtime authorization. Treat retrieved context and model output as untrusted; resist prompt injection. Do not enable unrestricted shell, arbitrary code, self-authorization, auto-merge, or deployment. Add tests proving unauthorized proposal blocked, limits enforced, cancellation propagated and policy outages fail closed. Acceptance: agent can propose only; governed runtime is sole execution path and emits traceable events.
